summary: The work between races: You lost or left, and {offerer} offers you {the job}.
realLife: One life: After losing two House races he hosted a statewide radio show, calling himself a decaf version of a famous host, and quit it to run for an open seat in 2000. Another: After losing his seat, he was recruited to a law and lobbying firm by Bob Dole, the former Republican Senate leader. Another: Weeks after resigning in 2014 he became vice chairman of an investment bank. Another: Fox News ended her contributor contract in 2013 after she began her Senate run. Another: After losing his first race in 1972 he went to law school and became a prosecutor.
